aiAccess.historyHint: Records only conversations sent through WinOne with a session ID. Off by default; never reads other clients' local history. Upstream size and retention limits apply. Stopping preserves existing records.
aiAccess.clearRecordingHint: Stops recording and permanently clears local gateway conversation text. Usage totals remain. This cannot be undone.
aiAccess.findSession: Find a client or session ID
aiAccess.sessionCut: This conversation exceeded the retention limit. Only retained content is shown.
aiAccess.nativeHint: Let unrestricted keys call any provider API outside the model list above. API-key providers only; keys restricted by models, accounts or budgets cannot use this.
aiAccess.title: Client access keys
aiAccess.hint: Give each client its own key. Every key follows the selection in Connection and models, and can further limit models, accounts, tools and usage.
aiAccess.newSecretHint: Use this as the client's API key. You can also copy it from its row after hiding this value.
aiAccess.name: Key name
aiAccess.ttlHint: For example 30m, 1h or 24h. Minimum 1 minute; maximum 30 days.
aiAccess.cost: Cost cap in USD (0 for no cap)
aiAccess.readOnlyHint: Read permitted status and usage without making model requests.
aiAccess.ownSecretHint: A new key can use the gateway's enabled models. Edit its scope and limits after creating it.
aiAccess.browserHint: This key cannot call models or issue other keys.
aiAccess.quotasHint: Let clients read remaining quota for accounts this key can use.
aiAccess.issuerHint: Issued keys inherit this key's restrictions and budget. Disabling this key revokes their access too.
aiAccess.scopeHint: One entry per line. Models use provider/model or group/name, with * supported. Accounts use provider/account ID. Empty fields follow the gateway scope.
aiAccess.cacheReads: Count cache reads against the token cap
aiAccess.limitModels: Models counted by this budget (empty for all)
aiAccess.revokeHint: The old key will stop working immediately. Clients using it will need an updated key.
aiAccess.oidc: Exchange workload identity for a temporary key
aiAccess.oidcHint: Verify an identity issuer, audience and claims before issuing a temporary key. Supports OIDC identities such as GitHub Actions. Rules take effect only after you add them.
aiAccess.chooseIssuer: Choose a key allowed to issue keys
aiAccess.identityURL: Identity issuer HTTPS URL (empty for GitHub Actions)
